neighbours.label: The second space of a two-space gap after a full stop that ends a complete sentence ('the dog barked.  Then it slept'). Weaker after ? or !; low on double spaces mid-sentence or after a comma, after abbreviations like 'Dr.', and on a single space after a full stop.
neighbours.short: two spaces after a sentence-ending full stop
fire: The dog barked.  Then it slept by the fire.
We missed the last train.  Nobody seemed surprised.
The report was finished on Friday.  It goes to the board next week.
She planted tomatoes in the spring.  By August the vines had covered the fence.
Preheat the oven to 200 degrees.  Grease the pan while you wait.
The meeting ended early.  Everyone went home.
Rain fell all night.  In the morning the river had risen two feet.
I checked the logs twice.  The error only appears after midnight.
quiet: The report was finished on Friday,  and it goes to the board next week.
She planted tomatoes in the  spring and by August the vines had covered the fence.
Preheat the oven to 200 degrees and grease the pan while you wait.
Dr.  Patel ended the meeting early and everyone went home.
Rain fell all  night, and in the morning the river had risen two feet.
I checked the logs twice, and the error only appears after midnight.
The museum opens at nine, and tickets are sold at the front desk.
Mr.  Hale closed the book and sighed after a long chapter.

predictions: Most fire sentences around 0.3 of max; mid-sentence and comma double spaces up to ~0.2; abbreviation cases ~0.1; single-space lines near 0.
